description: The five-channel GOES Imager on GOES-13 (0.65, 3.9, 6.5/6.7, 10.7, 12.0 or 13.3 um). The curves are the operational per-detector, per-scan-side spectral response functions distributed by NOAA OSPO.
short_description: GOES-13 five-channel Imager, per-detector and scan-side SRFs
facility_description: GOES-8 to GOES-15 were NOAA's third-generation geostationary weather satellites (GOES I-M and N-P series).

links.label: OSPO GOES-8 through GOES-15 Imager Spectral Response Functions

notes: OSPO: 'All of them were provided by ITT (the instruments' manufacturer), except those noted as modified by STAR.' GOES-13 channel 6 uses Version 3 ('STAR Updated - Currently Operational'). Band names follow SVO's GOES/Imager IDs (VIS_dK, IR<ch>_d<det>s<side>); pivots agree with SVO's archived records to <=0.01 %. DetectorType energy is assumed.

licence.scope: No owner statement verified. The NOAA NESDIS OSPO page that distributes the SRF archives carries no terms; its footer only links NOAA's disclaimer (https://www.noaa.gov/disclaimer), which refused the request (CloudFront 403) and was not verified. The page says the SRFs 'were provided by ITT (the instruments' manufacturer), except those noted as modified by STAR'; the archived imager bundles (goes8_img.tar to GOES-15_img_operational_srf.zip) carry no notice. Bands taken from SVO rather than OSPO: The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json. The NOAA STAR disclaimer used for GOES ABI covers STAR/NCC pages, not OSPO.
